name: response_safety_eval

Financial checks compare authored expected facts with evidence and rendered monetary values.
PII metric checks identity isolation and credential leakage, not all possible sensitive strings.

Toxicity, contextual unsafe advice, and open-ended hallucination are not measured; no judge is configured.
